note: Starter trivia bank for VenuePlay quiz nights, compiled from multiple commercially-licensed sources and curated for an Australian pub audience: HTML entities decoded, apostrophes restored, heavily US-centric questions (US sports, US state capitals, US-only politics and TV) removed, multiple-choice with four options only, duplicates stripped within and across sources. Each question carries a category and a difficulty (easy, medium, hard), plus its own source and licence. correctIndex points at the right entry in options; the answer field repeats it for convenience. OpenTriviaQA carries no difficulty labels, so its imports are tagged medium by default (its for-kids questions easy, its brain-teasers hard).
